competitors.strengths: Clean, accessible guide structure (anecdote, takeaways, product notes, comparison table, FAQ) that ranks 7 alternatives across price tiers with note breakdowns; easy to scan.
competitors.gaps: Blurs dupe vs. legitimate-alternative: presents Armaf clones (Pride of Armaf, Ventana) as equivalent to real houses like Prada and Bvlgari without ever flagging which is a copy of Sauvage's formula and which is an independent composition. No mention of Creed, PdM, or Giorgio Armani lines. No note on sillage/longevity axis being unverifiable claims.

competitors.strengths: Explicitly calls out synthetic clone guides as a problem and argues for genuinely different (natural/botanical) compositions rather than ambroxan copies -- a real point of differentiation most competitors skip.
competitors.gaps: Only recommends its own two house fragrances, so it is really a sales page dressed as a guide; ignores the broader market of established houses (Creed, YSL, Armani, Parfums de Marly) that Base Note actually stocks. No comparison table, no price context, no discussion of designer-tier real alternatives.

competitors.strengths: Positions itself around 'smell the same for less,' i.e. direct dupe/clone framing, which shows how strongly 'cheaper version' intent dominates this query -- useful signal for what NOT to do.
competitors.gaps: Leans entirely on clone logic (dupe-for-less), doesn't distinguish real fragrance houses at all, and never explains what makes Sauvage's ambroxan-bergamot structure work so a reader could evaluate an alternative on its own merits rather than 'close enough.'

notes: Autocomplete confirms two distinct search intents inside this one topic: (1) 'clone/dupe/cheap alternative' seekers (all 3 fetched competitors default to this framing, none cleanly separates real houses from Middle-Eastern clone houses like Armaf/Lattafa) and (2) 'which one is objectively better' comparison seekers (dior sauvage vs creed aventus / vs ysl y / vs acqua di gio, dior sauvage or bleu de chanel). Base Note's article should lead with #2 and treat #1 only to explicitly disqualify clones, which is a real content gap none of the three competitors fill well. WebSearch surfaced a 4th-tier of pure-clone sites (dupeperfumehub, houseofmoksha, asiscents, perfumes.la, whatscent) reinforcing that almost the entire SERP for this query is dupe-focused -- confirms the topic-sweep's 'zero authority owns the real-houses angle' read. No note-list conflicts found between post 52/06/51 and manufacturer pages in the excerpts pulled (Sauvage notes match Dior's current EDP listing: Calabrian bergamot, Sichuan pepper, lavender, star anise, vanilla, ambroxan) -- flag for the writer to still verify current note lists for GIT, Perseus, Profondo Parfum, Y Intense, Gentleman, Paradigme and Eros directly against each house's site since those weren't independently re-verified in this lane. Reminder for the writer: Paradigme, Gentleman and Eros are LOW STOCK per the brief -- do not lead with them or make them the first pick in any head-to-head.
